scripts.storage:setup: pnpm --filter @journey/contracts build && pnpm --filter @journey/api build && node apps/api/dist/scripts/setup-local.js && docker compose -f infra/compose.yaml up -d --wait
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @journey/contracts build && pnpm --filter @journey/api build && node apps/api/dist/scripts/migrate.js
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @journey/contracts build && concurrently -k -n TYPES,API,WEB "pnpm --filter @journey/contracts dev" "pnpm --filter @journey/api dev" "pnpm --filter @journey/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @journey/contracts build && pnpm --filter @journey/api build && pnpm --filter @journey/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @journey/contracts build && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @journey/contracts build && pnpm --filter @journey/api build && vitest run
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.data:backup: pnpm --filter @journey/contracts build && pnpm --filter @journey/api build && node apps/api/dist/scripts/data-backup.js backup
scripts.data:restore: pnpm --filter @journey/contracts build && pnpm --filter @journey/api build && node apps/api/dist/scripts/data-backup.js restore
scripts.data:retention: pnpm --filter @journey/contracts build && pnpm --filter @journey/api build && node apps/api/dist/scripts/retention.js
